content.text: West facade with three portal arches and a rose-window opening.
Facade landed facing the wrong way — I'll rebuild it at the other end so the portals face out.
Towers on the facade, with tall arched openings on three sides.
Stained-glass rose window — mixed trans 1×1 bricks filling the opening.
Rebuilding the rose glass properly, seated on the course below the opening.
Nave walls: four solid courses, long ring from the facade back to the apse.
Clerestory band — three courses with tall trans-colour nave windows.
Aisle outer walls with their own stained-glass windows, both sides.
Flying buttresses: piers, stepped flyers to the nave wall, and pinnacles.
Dark stepped roof over the nave, laid on a full-width deck.
Base plates stacked into a staircase — removing them; the cathedral stands clean.
Everything was resting on those plates — re-laying a proper ground-level plaza beneath the whole model.

build glass BEFORE the course above it (facade split into walls(5 courses) + rose glass + walls(5 more)).
